notes: «أبي» is the compiler's father, a bare kinship word with no name: relation. «بإسناده رفعه إلى» is a gap (unnamed) before the Imam, who is named after «إلى» inside the chain: narrator.
«- رحمه الله -» is an editor's gloss and is left out.

fixes.reason: RWY stores the gap and the Imam inside one name and has no Imam as its last link
